description: List the Internationally Active Insurance Groups (IAIGs) in the IAIS public register with their group-wide supervisor and jurisdiction, and for each the directory groups, entities and countries it controls across Africa, Europe, Asia-Pacific, South America and North America.

in_directory.description: true: only IAIGs with at least one licensed entity in this directory; false: only those without.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction of the group-wide supervisor, e.g. "France" or "United States".

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

name: list_iaigs

outputSchema.description: A JSON envelope. Successful results carry dataset, version, verified and licence plus the tool’s data; failures carry error, code and retryable.

verified.description: Date the dataset snapshot was verified.

version.description: Dataset version the result was read from.

title: List Internationally Active Insurance Groups
